description: The file is a PHP class named BestSeller that extends a controller within the OpenCart framework. It manages backend operations for a 'Bestseller' module in the OpenCart admin panel, including loading language files, handling CRUD operations for module settings, generating reports of bestseller products, and managing module installation, uninstallation, and synchronization.

classes.name: BestSeller
classes.description: A controller class for managing the Bestseller module in the OpenCart admin interface, including settings management, report generation, and module lifecycle methods.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to display the module settings page in the admin panel, load current settings, and prepare data for rendering.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the module configuration via AJAX, includes permission checks, validation, and response with JSON results.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Installs the bestseller module, calling the associated model method.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Removes the module, calling the appropriate model method.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Displays the bestseller report page, with pagination and product details.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Generates and returns the bestseller report data as a view.

methods.name: sync
methods.description: Synchronizes bestseller counts with current product sales data.
